vision: Empower treasury operations with a unified payment administration workspace that simplifies merchant and batch management, accelerates approvals, ensures audit integrity, and integrates seamlessly with PaymentCore and Payment Rail systems to handle cross-rail payouts efficiently.
scope: Deliver a Next.js + TypeScript UI connected to PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs through API Gateway. Enable search, drill-down, refunds, approvals, and anomaly alerts for treasury operations. Include audit logging to Kafka/S3 and enforce RBAC. Exclude non-core financial operations or external network integrations.
success_criteria: Search and payout workflows execute under defined performance thresholds (<1.5s for queries, <4s for payouts)
Audit logs are generated for all payment actions and verified in Kafka/S3
RBAC correctly restricts approval and refund actions based on roles (OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor)

user_stories.title: Enable treasury analyst to search merchants and payment batches across ACH, RTP, and wire rails
user_stories.i_want: to search and filter merchants and payment batches efficiently across multiple payment rails
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly identify transactions and exceptions without manual reconciliation

acceptance_criteria.given: a logged-in OpsAnalyst with proper RBAC access
acceptance_criteria.when: they enter search filters for a merchant or batch
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays results within 1.5 seconds from read-only replicas

user_stories.title: Display detailed settlement timeline and payment transaction drill-down view
user_stories.i_want: to view timeline details for settlements and batch transactions
user_stories.so_that: I can track the progress and status of each payment within a batch

acceptance_criteria.when: the analyst drills into the settlement timeline
acceptance_criteria.then: the system retrieves ledger and rail event data from PaymentCore GraphQL within 1.5 seconds

user_stories.title: Allow refund or adjustment initiation for an eligible transaction
user_stories.i_want: to trigger refunds or adjustments on qualifying payments
user_stories.so_that: I can resolve exceptions directly from the admin workspace

acceptance_criteria.given: a transaction marked eligible for refund
acceptance_criteria.then: an API call is made through Payment Actions service to Payment Rail REST endpoint and audit logs are emitted to Kafka and S3

user_stories.title: Enable manager approval of payout batches using automated allocation rules
user_stories.i_want: to review and approve payout batches with predefined allocation logic
user_stories.so_that: I can ensure accuracy and compliance for high-volume daily disbursements

acceptance_criteria.then: the system applies automated allocation rules, triggers PaymentCore mutation via Payment Actions service, and logs the event to audit.payments

user_stories.title: Surface payment anomaly alerts in the admin workspace dashboard
user_stories.i_want: to see anomaly alerts related to settlement discrepancies
user_stories.so_that: I can act early on irregular payment behaviors

acceptance_criteria.given: Payment Rail event streams detect anomalies
acceptance_criteria.then: alerts are displayed with relevant merchant and batch context

user_stories.title: Provide export functionality for audit-ready payment reports
user_stories.i_want: to export comprehensive reports of transactions and approvals
user_stories.so_that: I can perform audits without manual data extraction

acceptance_criteria.when: they trigger export for a selected timeframe
acceptance_criteria.then: the system generates an audit-ready CSV or JSON and archives it to S3
